# kinsta_site_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a domain of an environment and the DNS records Kinsta still asks for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kinsta_site" "blog" {
  name = "blog"
}

data "kinsta_site_domain" "apex" {
  environment_id = data.kinsta_site.blog.live_environment_id
  domain_name    = "example.com"
}

output "records_still_needed" {
  value = concat(
    data.kinsta_site_domain.apex.verification_records,
    data.kinsta_site_domain.apex.pointing_records,
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String) Domain name.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site domain ID.
- `pointing_records` (Attributes List) DNS records that point the domain at the site. Empty once the domain is verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pointing_records))
- `uses_cloudflare_dns` (Boolean) Whether Kinsta reports the domain as using Cloudflare DNS.
- `verification_records` (Attributes List) DNS records Kinsta needs to verify ownership of the domain. Empty once the domain is verified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification_records))

<a id="nestedatt--pointing_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pointing_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.


<a id="nestedatt--verification_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name.
- `type` (String) Record type.
- `value` (String) Record value.
